# Orbit animation assets

- `Stylized_World_Topo_5400x2700.jpeg` is the Earth texture used by the
  ICESat2VegR orbit animation and retained here so the GEDI adaptation has the
  same globe presentation.
- `ISS-NASA-transparent.png` is a transparent-background adaptation of NASA's
  International Space Station illustration, credited to NASA and downloaded
  from <https://science.nasa.gov/resource/international-space-station/>.

The ISS image is used only as the moving station marker in
`plot_gedi_orbit_animation()`.
